verdicts.reason: The two layouts are the same apart from one detail. In A, the left arrow beside 'YOUR EFFICIENT' is blown up to about 3x the size of the right arrow, so the kicker line looks broken and lopsided. B keeps both arrows small and matching, as in the original. Both share the same faults: the original is close to a plain scale-up, and the illustration panel no longer fills the full height, which leaves awkward light-blue bands above and below it. The left blue strip is also clipped thin, and there is a lot of dead white space around the headline.
